from collections import Counter
def f(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    uniq=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg and cnt[v]==1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; U=set(uniq)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg: continue
            hit=False
            for di,dj in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:
                k=1
                while True:
                    i2,j2=i+di*k,j+dj*k
                    if not (0<=i2<h and 0<=j2<w): break
                    if (i2,j2) in U: hit=True; break
                    if g[i2][j2]!=bg: break
                    k+=1
            if hit: out[i][j]=1
    return out
